scripts.release:patch: pnpm version patch --no-commit-hooks && git push origin HEAD:main --follow-tags
scripts.release:minor: pnpm version minor --no-commit-hooks && git push origin HEAD:main --follow-tags
scripts.release:major: pnpm version major --no-commit-hooks && git push origin HEAD:main --follow-tags
scripts.postinstall: if command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1; then git config core.hooksPath .githooks; fi
